description: Standalone Web IDE with Multi-Document Tabs & Direct Disk Persistence
author: KeshavSoft
features: Independent Monaco models with isolated undo/redo history
Native File System Access API (Open & Direct Disk Save via Ctrl+S)
Per-tab dirty change tracking with amber dot indicator
Built-in code formatter (JSON, JS, TS, HTML, CSS)
Tab close protection against accidental loss of unsaved edits
AOT compiled styling with zero runtime bloat

quickTips.newTab: Click '+' on the tab strip or press Ctrl+O to open another file into a new tab
quickTips.switchTab: Click any tab to switch editor buffer with zero latency
quickTips.save: Press Ctrl+S to save the active file directly back to disk
quickTips.format: Press Shift+Alt+F to format the current document
